statement: Warren 2026-10-19: the sell-through column-mapping step offers these standard columns. Main list: Period (sale date, week or month); Sales model / marketing name; Part number; Barcode (EAN or UPC); Customer product code; Units sold; On-hand (stock; not required when Sales-only is ticked); Unit cost; Unit sell price; Total line cost; Total revenue; Store / site; Listing ID (website listing, e.g. ASIN/TSIN). Under 'More columns': unit MAC, marketplace, on-hand value, in-transit units, on-order units.
